Data layers
The model’s numbers for each area (2020 census block groups), for the year and plan selected. Tap an area on the map for its numbers.

      Click a station, or type a station or a street address. Right-click (long-press on a phone) the map to start or end anywhere.

      Lines
      Year it opens (“today” if it runs now) · daily trips it adds per $1M of its capital cost (the trips lost if it were removed, ÷ cost; higher is better value).
      Numbers from the model in the repository; see reports/RESULTS.md for definitions. Demand is a gravity model from census population and LODES jobs. Experimental: networks generated from scratch
